high_finding_reassessment.basis: verify_snapshot schema-checks rich archive and manifest entries, compares their exact metadata, recomputes the denominator digest, and the untouched-bundle replay test passes while tampering still rejects.

The producer rediscoveres and compares full denominator path/metadata/content before and after the seam in addition to HEAD, branch, porcelain, and staged-diff hashes; the already-dirty byte-drift adversary aborts with unchanged Git status.

The v2 bundle emits a strict v1 archive, manifest, state artifacts, and sourceSnapshot projection; a producer-written projection is accepted end-to-end by the unchanged R0 validate_candidate contract.

Reachable in-repository extends targets are recursively parsed and added, including non-tsconfig-named nested targets and workspace exports; staged and unstaged deletions are unioned and baseline-archived.

The actual symbolic branch, Git top-level, and sole worktree root are required, and modes derive from lstat/baseline tree; non-master, alternate-root, second-worktree, and executable-mode adversaries pass.
